# K-Drama.Life

> > A comprehensive Russian-language streaming platform for Asian dramas with professional voiceovers, featuring Korean, Chinese, Thai, and Japanese series including BL content.

K-Drama.Life provides free online access to Asian television content with Russian dubbing by professional translation groups like FSG White, FSG SecretStory.Subtitles, and DubLik.Tv. The site specializes in completed and ongoing series across multiple genres, with strong coverage of BL (Boys' Love) content from Thailand, Korea, China, and Japan.

## Key Topics

- Russian voiceover (озвучка)
- BL series (yaoi)
- Korean dramas (дорамы)
- Chinese dramas
- Thai lakorns
- Japanese dramas
- FSG translation groups
- MyDramalist integration
- Romance genre
- Mystery thrillers
- Completed series
- Ongoing releases 2025
- HD streaming
- His Man reality show
- DubLik.Tv platform

## Core Catalogs

- [Completed Dramas](https://k-drama.life/zakonchennye): Completed Asian dramas catalog with Russian voiceover, all finished series
- [BL Lakorns Collection](https://k-drama.life/bl-lakorny): Best BL Thai lakorns with Russian voiceover, yaoi romance collection
- [Adventure Genre](https://k-drama.life/priklyucheniya): Adventure genre dramas, Japanese and Asian action series catalog
- [Unrequited Love Theme](https://k-drama.life/tematika/bezotvetnaya-lyubov): Unrequited love themed dramas, BL and romance series collection

## 2025 New Releases

- [Human Specimens](https://k-drama.life/6465-chelovecheskie-obrazcy.html): Ningen Hyohon (2025) Japanese psychological thriller with Nishijima
- [That Summer](https://k-drama.life/6252-tem-letom.html): That Summer (2025) Thai BL romance with amnesia theme, ongoing series
- [My Dear Secretary](https://k-drama.life/6497-moj-dorogoj-sekretar.html): Chinese office romance drama (2025) with secretary-boss relationship
- [Queen of Darkness](https://k-drama.life/6356-koroleva-tmy.html): Hei Ye Zhong De Ta (2025) Chinese mystery romance with memory loss
- [Legend of Five Immortals](https://k-drama.life/6373-legenda-o-pjati-bessmertnyh.html): Wu Xian Gui Shi Lu (2025) Chinese supernatural thriller, republican era
- [Bowing Before You](https://k-drama.life/6390-preklonjajas-pered-toboj.html): Zhe Yao (2025) Chinese historical romance with political marriage theme
- [Beautiful Avenger](https://k-drama.life/6326-prekrasnaja-mstitelnica.html): The Spring Avenger (2025) Chinese revenge mystery web series
- [I Accidentally Joined Cool Guys Group](https://k-drama.life/6328-ja-sluchajno-prisoedinilsja-k-gruppe-krutyh-parnej-vo-vremja-shkolnoj-poezdki.html): Japanese BL school drama (2025) about high school trip friendship
